summary: This clinical trial compares two different treatments, Insulin Degludec/Liraglutide Injection and XULTOPHY, given as shots under the skin for adults with type 2 diabetes. Type 2 diabetes is a condition where the body cannot properly control its blood sugar levels. The study is being done in multiple locations to see how well the treatments work and how safe they are. Participants will be monitored over a 26-week period.
